What is the range of the MS Jaguar MISO 3-W on a full charge?

The MISO 3-W runs on a 72V/32Ah battery, delivering up to 80 km on a single charge, ideal for daily city commuting.How long does the MISO 3-W take to charge?

A full charge takes approximately 5–6 hours from a standard household socket.Is the MS Jaguar MISO 3-W suitable for family and female riders?

Yes, the three-wheel design adds stability at low speeds and while parked, making it easier to balance and ride. Combined with its retro, compact frame and low seat height, it's a comfortable option for families and female riders.What is the top speed of the MS Jaguar MISO 3-W?

Up to 45 km/h, powered by an 800–1000W multi-mode BLDC motor.Does the MISO 3-W have a warranty?

Yes, an 18-month battery warranty, backed by MS Jaguar's nationwide dealer network.What colors does the MISO 3-W come in?

Blush Pink, Cream White, and Deep Black.What braking and wheel setup does the MISO 3-W have?

It comes with a front disc braking system and 10-inch alloy rims for stable, reliable stopping power.Why choose a three-wheeler over a two-wheeled scooter?

The added third wheel improves balance and stability, especially at low speeds, stops, and while parked, making the MISO 3-W a confidence-inspiring option for new riders or anyone wanting extra stability day to day.Is the MISO 3-W affordable compared to other 3-wheelers?

Yes, the MISO 3-W is positioned as the most affordable three-wheeler in the market, making the stability and comfort of a 3-wheel EV accessible at a lower price point than typical.
